## 🚀 About Me

<img align="right" alt="coding" width="300" src="https://media.giphy.com/media/qgQUggAC3Pfv687qPC/giphy.gif" />

I'm **Mubashir Ahmed**, a **Frontend Developer** based in Karachi, Pakistan, currently sharpening my skills at **Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT)**. My journey started with the building blocks of the web — **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript** — and I'm now expanding into full-stack development with a growing passion for architecture, clean code, and AI-powered products.

I'm a self-learner at heart. I **build to understand**, **read to refine**, and treat every project as a stepping stone toward becoming a well-rounded engineer.

- 🎯 **Current Focus**: Mastering full-stack development and web architecture
- 🧠 **Interests**: Modern web technologies, clean code, user-centric design
- 📚 **Learning**: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, API integration & AI/ML
- 💡 **Passion**: Creating elegant solutions to real-world problems
- 🤝 **Community**: Always open to collaboration and knowledge sharing
